ops.title: live-dashboard: list git worktrees only when a stood-down non-owner candidate exists
ops.description: components/cci.py worktrees(ctx) runs git -C <checkout> worktree list --porcelain on the shared monorepo gitdir at the lanes component's 1m cadence in every dashboard. Seven verified callers summed 391% of one core (2026-10-16, /tmp/host-relief-20261015-1939/dashboard-worktree-poll-0543.json). Skip the query when no stood-down non-owner candidate needs resolving. No dashboard restarts as part of the fix.
